definitions.explanation: A dictionary that provides English translations and explanations for Japanese words. The counterpart to an English-Japanese dictionary ({英和辞典|えいわじてん}).

examples.japanese: {和英辞典|わえいじてん}で{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I looked it up in a Japanese-English dictionary.

examples.japanese: {英作文|えいさくぶん}を{書|か}くときは{和英辞典|わえいじてん}が{役|やく}に{立|た}つ。
examples.english: A Japanese-English dictionary is useful when writing English compositions.

examples.japanese: この{和英辞典|わえいじてん}は{用例|ようれい}が{豊富|ほうふ}で、{微妙|びみょう}なニュアンスの{違|ちが}いもよく{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: This Japanese-English dictionary is rich in usage examples and helps you understand subtle nuance differences.

notes:
Composed of {和|わ} (Japanese), {英|えい} (English), and {辞典|じてん} (dictionary). The {和|わ} here is the same prefix seen in {和食|わしょく} (Japanese food) and {和風|わふう} (Japanese style). In the Japanese naming convention for bilingual dictionaries, the source language comes first: {和英|わえい} means Japanese-to-English, while {英和|えいわ} means English-to-Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和英辞典|わえいじてん}を{引|ひ}く: to look up in a J-E dictionary
- {和英辞典|わえいじてん}で{調|しら}べる: to check in a J-E dictionary
- {電子|でんし}{和英辞典|わえいじてん}: electronic J-E dictionary
- オンライン{和英辞典|わえいじてん}: online J-E dictionary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {英和辞典|えいわじてん}: English-Japanese dictionary — the reverse direction, used when reading English
- {国語辞典|こくごじてん}: Japanese-Japanese dictionary — a monolingual dictionary for native speakers
- {辞書|じしょ}: dictionary — the general, everyday word for any dictionary
- {辞典|じてん}: dictionary — more formal than {辞書|じしょ}, often used in the titles of specific published dictionaries
